healthcareTrends2025_2027.summary: Hospital associations prioritize nursing/allied health pipelines, retention incentives, and virtual recruiting.
Coverage gaps, wait times, telehealth policy, and rural access remain top advocacy themes.
Staff safety legislation, reporting, and mandatory training drive coalition campaigns.
Parity, crisis services, and workforce shortages cross state and federal agendas.
Mortality prevention coalitions tie education, workforce, and policy campaigns.
Screening workflows and community benefit programs link clinical ops to advocacy.
CE, credentials, virtual events, and mobile-first executives expect modern UX.
Grassroots, legislator engagement, issue campaigns — PAC compliance stays legally bounded.
